Camera.label: Camera
Camera.description: This LWM2M Object includes camera information.

Connection_Status.label: Connection Status
Connection_Status.description: The Connection Status of the camera, 1:On, 0:Off.

Working_Status.label: Working Status
Working_Status.description: The Working Status of the camera, 0:Recording, 1:Playing, 2:Paused.

Local_Recording.label: Local Recording
Local_Recording.description: If Local Recording is enabled or not, 1:Enabled, 0:Disabled.

Image_Matting.label: Image Matting
Image_Matting.description: If Image Matting is enabled or not, 1:Enabled, 0:Disabled.

Camera_Snapshot.label: Camera Snapshot
Camera_Snapshot.description:
If Camera Snapshot is enabled or not(in Dangerous Situation), 
				1:Enabled, 0:Disabled.

Camera_Recording.label: Camera Recording
Camera_Recording.description:
If Camera Recording is enabled or not(in Dangerous Situation), 
				1:Enabled, 0:Disabled.

Camera_Snapshot_Control.label: Camera Snapshot Control
Camera_Snapshot_Control.description: Enable/Disable Camera Snapshot in Dangerous Situation: Parameter: 1:Enable, 0:Disable

Camera_Recording_Control.label: Camera Recording Control
Camera_Recording_Control.description: Enable/Disable Camera Recording in Dangerous Situation: Parameter: 1:Enable, 0:Disable
